family.tagline: A retired couple, one Companion Core, and a table that fills most weekends.
family.story: Harpreet, a retired electrician, cooks for friends most weekends. Jaswinder, a retired pharmacist, keeps the papers, plans and trips in order from the Reading Lounge. One Companion Core serves them both.

members.name: Harpreet
members.work: retired electrician who hosts and cooks

companion.name: Cardamom
companion.job: Drafts Harpreet’s group messages to friends from the notes he types.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Harpreet reads and sends every message himself.

companion.name: Cumin
companion.job: Drafts replies to Jaswinder’s letters and emails from the points she gives.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Jaswinder reads every word and sends it herself.

popup.title: Harpreet carries the Core inside
popup.body: The Companion Core waits in a parcel at the top of the front steps. Harpreet carries it to the Hearth Salon credenza.

popup.title: Unbox the Companion Core
popup.body: Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Jaswinder reads the guide aloud while Harpreet lifts the Core out.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Harpreet plugs in the cable, and Jaswinder presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: On the sofa, Jaswinder joins the Core’s own network from her phone’s Wi-Fi settings, then picks the home network.

popup.title: Pick the first agent and apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Jaswinder picks Hermes, and the couple add Immich and KitchenOwl. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Cumin says hello
popup.body: Jaswinder messages the agent she named Cumin. The answer comes back through her chat, worked out on the Core.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: jaswinder
say.text: Hello, Jaswinder. I am Cumin. What shall we start with?

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: The spring parade plays again
popup.body: A visiting friend missed the spring parade, so Harpreet plays his own video. Jellyfin serves it from the Core to the tablet in his hand.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: Harpreet looks up three addresses
popup.body: Cards for three autumn anniversaries need addresses. At the coffee table, Harpreet looks them up in the shared Nextcloud contacts Jaswinder keeps. The Core serves them to his phone.

beats.capability: scan and file your paperwork; it reads every page, tags it and makes it searchable

popup.title: Jaswinder scans the certificate
popup.body: Jaswinder takes Harpreet’s apprenticeship certificate off the shelf and scans it. Paperless-ngx reads and tags the scan on the Core, so she finds it later by a word on it.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: A lamp warms before she reads
popup.body: Jaswinder reads at nine each morning. Harpreet sets a Home Assistant rule on the Core, so the floor lamp’s Wi-Fi bulb comes on before she sits.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Jaswinder answers the council
popup.body: The council’s river path letter needs an answer. Jaswinder gives Cumin three points, and Cumin drafts it on the Core’s local model. Jaswinder reads it, then sends it herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: jaswinder
say.text: The draft is ready. Please read every line before you send it.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host; works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: One sign-in reaches both phones
popup.body: Jaswinder saves the plumber’s sign-in in VaultWarden. Harpreet finds it on his phone through the Bitwarden apps. The vault runs on the Core.

beats.capability: plan tasks and time blocks in one local file on your Core

popup.title: Jaswinder blocks out her week
popup.body: Morning light fills the Garden Room while Jaswinder sets time aside for each of the week’s tasks in Companion Planning. The plan is one local file on the Core.

beats.capability: track accounts, budgets, bills and savings goals, with rules that sort your transactions

popup.title: The water bill finds its line
popup.body: On the first of the month, bills cover the oval table. Jaswinder types the water bill into Firefly III on the Core, and a rule sorts it.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: Eight for lunch needs one list
popup.body: Eight friends are coming on Sunday. KitchenOwl on the Core holds the list: Harpreet writes it at the breakfast bar, and Jaswinder adds mint.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: The dal he never wrote down
popup.body: Harpreet has cooked his dal by feel for decades. At the counter he measures each spice and types the steps into the KitchenOwl recipe book. Now Jaswinder can cook it.

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Jaswinder clears the fridge door
popup.body: Jaswinder retires three paper calendars from the fridge door. One Yuvomi calendar now holds the window cleaner and the weekend guests, in a database on the Core.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Cardamom drafts while the pot simmers
popup.body: Between stirs, Harpreet types Cardamom a note on who is bringing what. Cardamom drafts the group message on the Core’s local model, and Harpreet reads it and sends it himself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: harpreet
say.text: The message is ready. Read it first, then send it yourself.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: Harpreet writes down the watering
popup.body: Tuesday morning, Harpreet waters the planters. In the HortusFox journal on the Core, he adds the date and a photo.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: Harpreet peels while she listens
popup.body: On the cabana sofa, Jaswinder follows the book club novel while Harpreet peels garlic beside her. Audiobookshelf, running on the Core, remembers her place.

beats.capability: log your flights and see your whole travel history on a world map

popup.title: Jaswinder logs flights to her sister
popup.body: At the Dressing Room vanity, Jaswinder logs last year’s flights to her sister. Each one joins the travel history AirTrail keeps on the Core.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: The wedding album goes in once
popup.body: The wedding album is coming apart at the spine, so Harpreet scans its pages into Immich. The scans sit on the Core, where he can search them.
popup.note: The first start takes a while.

popup.title: One Core runs a river house
popup.body: Photographs, passwords, plans and recipes run on one Companion Core, in a villa beside the river.

closing.body: Your albums, bills and recipes can live on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: No TV or screen is written: the house is flagged hall-only. The media beat at the couch is living-parade, Jellyfin to a tablet in Harpreet’s hand, no TV implied. Audiobookshelf sits at the cabana sofa (patio-seat nth 5).

Anchors: couch nth 0 Hearth Salon sofa, nth 1 Garden Room sectional, nth 2 Reading Lounge chaise; room living nth 1 Hearth Salon, nth 2 Reading Lounge, nth 3 Bay Seat; desk bedroom nth 0 Dressing Room vanity.
Both companions are Hermes. Chat note rides on ftue-hello, reading-cumin and kitchen-range; people read and send every message. No Companion Memory is named.
Firefly III: bookkeeping only, no bank import named, no advice. AirTrail and Firefly III chips use catalog replaces names (Flighty, Mint).
Immich beat names the Core and no photo cloud; the first-start caveat rides as a note on bedroom-prints and ftue-pick.
No beat is a small-business beat; no QA-screenshot gap: every app named has a screenshot, nothing is added to reviewed.json.
